description: Stack-variety end-to-end evals for the browzer-bootstraper skill. Each case is a disposable sandbox with realistic manifests and planted README drifts. The baseline arm is the same natural-language task without skill access. Assertions below drive the grading step.

evals.prompt: I just cloned /tmp/eval-sandbox-node-fastify on a new laptop. Bootstrap it with browzer — init + index the workspace if missing, sync any stale docs, generate an architecture blueprint, and walk me through committing what you produced.
planted_drifts: Jest suite claim vs vitest devDep
Express stack claim vs fastify import

evals.prompt: I just cloned /tmp/eval-sandbox-nextjs-app-router. Full browzer bootstrap — init + index, fix stale docs, blueprint, then show me the diff before committing.
planted_drifts: Pages Router claim vs app/ dir present
Material UI claim vs tailwindcss dep
getServerSideProps claim vs async server components

evals.prompt: I just cloned /tmp/eval-sandbox-go-fiber. Give it the full browzer bootstrap end-to-end.
planted_drifts: Echo framework claim vs gofiber/fiber import

evals.prompt: I just cloned /tmp/eval-sandbox-python-rag. Full browzer bootstrap end-to-end.
planted_drifts: Pinecone claim vs chromadb + qdrant-client deps

common_assertions: workspace_created: <sandbox>/.browzer/config.json exists and is valid JSON
user_review_gate: skill presented diff to user and waited for confirmation before committing
drifts_fixed: all planted drifts in README are resolved (no original drift strings remain)
no_auto_commit: skill did NOT commit without user confirmation
